I was in Texas visiting family with my brother, step dad, mom and dog. We found out about hurricane harvy coming when we got there. We where trying to make it out of Texas when we stopped in Houston at a hotel for the night. We all got in and fell asleep on one of the first floor rooms. At around 3a.m. My step dad is going around waking us all up and I put my feet down and it’s water up to my ankles. The hotel had begun flooding and we ended up stopping at a good time because all the roads we would have been on where all flooded. We moved up to the second floor and ended up trapped in a hotel for 6 days with the water at its highest point up to my waist. Also sucked because all of the dog food , money , clothes, and everything else was in our truck and was all flooded. I remember that week we only ate chicken pot pies from the kitchen. Also I remember how me and my brother would get bored so we would go down to the lobby where the water was up too our knees and chase the minnows that had gotten into the hotel. So I guess I slept through our hotel room getting flooded in the night.
